parameters.prompt: A cute clay figure of a person wearing a homemade robot costume made from cardboard boxes, trying hard to pass as a robot: a cardboard box over the head, painted teal with uneven brush strokes, with two eye slots cut out where the person's eyes peek through, and a bent coat-hanger antenna with a ping-pong ball taped on top. A bigger teal-painted cardboard box is worn as the body on shoulder straps, with silver duct tape on the seams, bottle-cap buttons glued on, and a red and cream knitted scarf. The person's own arms in a striped long-sleeve shirt and garden gloves stick out of holes in the sides, and their legs in jeans and sneakers show below the box. Waving cheerfully. Clearly a human in a costume, funny and endearing. Polished, cinematic claymation short film look: smooth saturated matte modeling clay with subtle thumbprints, chunky rounded toy-like forms, soft warm theater lighting with a gentle rim light, shallow depth of field. Standing on a warm wooden theater stage in front of a softly blurred deep red velvet curtain, lit by a soft spotlight. Full body, three-quarter front view, centered and in frame. A single character, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no badges.
